entries.38ee9b7098cddcf4: It handles environmental test equipment, hydraulic equipment, pneumatic equipment, industrial robots and constant-temperature baths, and it also performs contract measurement. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥6,328 million.
entries.4953dddc58664d71: It handles electrical measuring instruments such as ammeters, voltmeters, power measuring instruments and recorders, as well as oscilloscopes, communication measuring instruments and measurement systems. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,801 million.
entries.4ea9acfa1ed846b5: This is a single-segment business that sells various electronic applied equipment, such as measurement and control instruments and physics and chemistry instruments, and performs the engineering work that accompanies those sales. As an agency for [[company:yokogawa-electric|Yokogawa Electric Corporation]], Yokogawa Solution Service Corporation and Agilent Technologies Japan, Ltd., it purchases the main products; for system sales, it orders machinery and instrumentation construction work from engineering and construction companies, which manufacture and install them. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥45,220 million.
entries.56a47f9c1df54709: It handles control computers and computer systems for process automation (PA) and factory automation (FA), detection instruments such as thermometers and flowmeters, and control devices such as controllers and sequencers, and it takes on engineering, software production, instrumentation construction and maintenance services. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥22,571 million.
entries.d9a01a0110d7c093: An engineering trading company that sells measurement and control instruments and scientific instruments, and handles instrumentation work and maintenance as a package.
entries.fc6345ae5e2f9216: It handles organic chemical analysis equipment such as gas chromatographs and liquid chromatographs, and inorganic analysis equipment such as ICP mass spectrometers, and it also produces software for analytical data. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥10,518 million.
